name: Notion Templates / Digital Products

yield.notes: Wide range: most templates earn <$100/mo; viral or niche templates can earn $1k+/mo.

flags: Notion may break templates on major updates

prerequisites: Payment processor (Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, or Payhip)
startup_checklist: Identify a pain point you personally solve with Notion (project tracker, content calendar, budget planner)
Build template in Notion, duplicate link, set to 'Allow duplicate' in share settings
Create product listing on Gumroad with screenshots, description, and price ($7–$47)
Post in 3 relevant communities (Reddit r/Notion, Twitter, LinkedIn) explaining the problem it solves
Collect 5 testimonials from free beta users before raising price
failure_modes: Template gets copied/pirated and shared for free
Audience too small to generate consistent sales
Notion platform changes break core functionality
kill_criteria: Less than 5 sales after 90 days of consistent promotion
Platform fee + payment processing eats >40% of revenue
sources_note: Income ranges from creator community surveys and public case studies.
